title: Normalized derived squares: pasted-unit equation of their mates
statement: For abelian C,D,C′,D′ with derived categories in a common universe and K-injective resolutions [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-pur-kinjective-complex], take additive F:C→D, K:C′→D′, G:D→D′, H:C→C′, P:C′→C, Q:D′→D, exact G,H, and adjunctions ah:H⊣P and ag:G⊣Q [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived]. For any natural transformation m:F;G→H;K and β:RF;D(G)→D(H);RK, assume U(F,G);Qh(RF;RG→RF;D(G));Qh(β)=Qh(m);U(H,K);Qh(RH;RK→D(H);RK), where the exact comparisons are rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. Then U(P,F);Qh(mate(β))=Qh(mate(m));U(K,Q), using the exact-left-adjoint derived adjunctions for mate(β). Neither H preserving K-injectives nor invertibility of m, β, or their mates is assumed. No comparison ed is given or identified in this claim.

source.place: derivedη_fac_app, derivedε_fac_app and Adjunction.derived; Stacks Project, cohomology.tex, Tag 079W

proof.text: Evaluate at a homotopy object X of C′. Expand U(P,F) and the forward mate of β. Use naturality of the derived G-unit to move the F-unit through it, and naturality of β to move the right-derived P-unit through β. Apply the normalized-square equation hβ at P.mapHomotopyCategory.obj X.

Use the factorization of the exact identifications RG≅D(G), RH≅D(H), and derivedη_fac_app for G and derivedε_fac_app for H. Naturality of the localization factor isomorphisms and derived units replaces the remaining composite by the localized ordinary G-unit, Q-image of m evaluated at P(X), and H-counit followed by U(K,Q). This is the defining forward mate formula. Associators and unitors cancel componentwise.
